reading_rules: CD-138(b) — task_mode, admitted_set, selected and parts are DECLARED. No gate derives them from a header marker string (যেকোনো একটা · অথবা · বা · ও · + · ভেঙে). Those tokens are authoring evidence only.
CD-138(d) — demand is PAPER-LEVEL. items_per_paper and marks are separate facts: BAN C5 totals 56 items and 100 marks. Only the marks column totals 100.
CD-138(f) — chapter_authorable is DERIVED from each chapter bank header's admissibility declaration. It is NOT authored in this file and no slot row carries it.
CD-138(g) — an admissible chapter owes the full per-slot items_per_paper, capped by PENDING-P-036's min().
CD-139 — S14/S15 exclusion is a per-chapter content declaration, not a slot-level rule.
CD-140 — BAN-S12 C2 (১০টি × ১) and BAN-S09 C3 (৫টি × ২) are RULED item splits, not derived. The spine gives those two cells a total and no ×n, and CD-138(d) forbids inventing a divisor.

Principal 2026-08-15 — D5 rows record ABSENCE and carry no task fields; D6 rows are the school's own questions, keyed (L-id, class) because L-ids repeat across classes at different marks. Both are skipped by COVERAGE: existence is a CLASS-level fact, admissibility a CHAPTER-level one, and they are never one field.

I-1_marks_total.note: Each class's L-rows are ALSO cross-read against that class's own স্কুলের নিজস্ব প্রশ্ন cell in the spine's নম্বরের ধাপ table — two independent statements in the spine, checked against each other. This replaces the arithmetic check D6 rows cannot have, because the spine states no item split for any of its eight L-rows.

I-4_half_marks.note: BAN uses no half marks at any class. The sole half-mark site in the whole structure is ENG S10 (0.5×10), and it is not in this file.

I-6_cause_codes.expected: every row carries a d_code, D5 and D6 rows included

I-8_gap_rule.note: All five columns are built, so the rule is testable for the first time. Seven slots start late — S01 (C4) · S06 (C3) · S08 (C2) · S09 (C3) · S10 (C2) · S11 (C2) · S13 (C3) — and every one of them is a LEADING PREFIX, not a hole. C1's S11 absence is the one to read carefully: বিরামচিহ্ন is not missing at C1, it is inside S03's composite under যোগ্যতা ১৩.৩.

All three constraints carried here now attach to real rows, and the fourth defect this block could not hold is why the L-row shape was ruled: E-AUTHOR-ENDORSE → (BAN-S01, C4) · BAN-S12-C1-NO-BHENGE → (BAN-S12, C1) · BAN-S15-GUIDED → (BAN-S15, C1) and (BAN-S15, C2) · BAN-L03-C1-NO-FOLA → (BAN-L03, C1), which had NO row to attach to until D6 rows existed. rows.evidence_note: COMPOSITE, AND THE PARTS ARE NOT THE C5 PARTS. যোগ্যতা ১৩.৩ is বিরামচিহ্নসহ বাক্য লেখা — one competency, not two — so an item scoring 1 would not test the punctuation half at all.
